title: Overall fit, size, and comfort praise
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe the G60 as feeling close to perfect overall, with praise for ride quality, right-sized packaging, good fit, and convenient preconditioning comfort.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as an excellent overall fit, with standout comments on ride feel, size, general satisfaction, and preconditioning to a comfortable cabin temperature.

mixed.summary: The mixed review pairs broad approval with a specific complaint that the seat shape is too curved and needs a flatter adjustment for comfort.

limitations: This topic includes several different ideas under the word 'perfect,' including overall satisfaction, ride quality, size, seat comfort, and cabin preconditioning, so the cluster is somewhat broad.
Examples are brief and provide limited detail on why owners describe the vehicle as 'perfect.'
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 reviews.
